cases.expected: NumericIndicator whose delegate returns the close price of each bar; getValue(0) == 100.5, getValue(1) == 101.2
cases.description: Verify that closePrice creates a NumericIndicator that correctly wraps a ClosePriceIndicator for a typical BarSeries containing two bars with known close prices.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator whose delegate returns the only close price; getValue(0) == 55.0
cases.description: Check behavior when the BarSeries contains exactly one bar – the returned NumericIndicator should still provide the correct close price.

cases.expected: IndexOutOfBoundsException when calling getValue(0) on the returned NumericIndicator
cases.description: An empty BarSeries has no bars; the NumericIndicator should be created but any attempt to access a value should raise an IndexOutOfBoundsException.
Passing a null BarSeries should cause a NullPointerException because ClosePriceIndicator requires a non‑null series.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator whose delegate returns the close price of each bar; getValue(0) == 10.0, getValue(2) == 30.5, getValue(4) == 50.0
cases.description: Validate that closePrice correctly wraps a ClosePriceIndicator for a typical series with five bars and that values are accessible at arbitrary indices.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator whose delegate returns extreme close prices; getValue(0) == Double.MAX_VALUE, getValue(1) == Double.MIN_VALUE, getValue(2) == 0.0, getValue(3) == -12345.678
cases.description: Check handling of very large, very small, zero and negative close prices to ensure no overflow or sign errors.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator whose delegate returns the same close price for all bars; getValue(i) == 42.42 for any valid i
cases.description: Confirm that a series where every bar has the identical close price yields identical values from the NumericIndicator.

cases.expected: After appending a new bar with close price 200.0 to the series, the previously created NumericIndicator reflects the new value at the new index (getValue(2) == 200.0)
cases.description: Ensure that the NumericIndicator is live‑linked to the underlying BarSeries and reflects changes made after its creation.

cases.expected: Two separate calls to closePrice(fiveBarSeries) return distinct NumericIndicator instances (different object identity) but their delegates produce identical values for all indices.
cases.description: Verify that closePrice creates a new NumericIndicator each time rather than returning a cached instance.

cases.expected: The NumericIndicator returned by closePrice reports getBarSeries() == fiveBarSeries and getUnstableBars() == 0
cases.description: Check that the wrapper correctly propagates the original BarSeries reference and reports zero unstable bars (ClosePriceIndicator is stable).

cases.expected: NumericIndicator whose delegate returns Num.NaN for bars where the close price is undefined; getValue(1).isNaN() == true
cases.description: Test behavior when a bar’s close price is NaN (e.g., missing data); the indicator should propagate the NaN value without throwing.

cases.expected: NullPointerException when calling getValue(0) on the returned NumericIndicator because the underlying BarSeries contains a null Bar.
cases.description: Validate that closePrice propagates a NullPointerException when the BarSeries includes a null Bar element; the ClosePriceIndicator will attempt to access the bar's close price and fail.

cases.expected: NullPointerException when calling getValue(0) on the returned NumericIndicator because the Bar's close price is null.
cases.description: Test behavior when a Bar in the series has a null close price; the ClosePriceIndicator should throw a NullPointerException when retrieving that value.

cases.expected: RuntimeException (or the specific exception thrown by the faulty series) when calling getValue(0) on the returned NumericIndicator.
cases.description: Ensure that any unchecked exception thrown by a custom BarSeries implementation during bar access propagates through the NumericIndicator created by closePrice.
